hookLine: A daughter vanished steps from her mother's home

cards.title: The Discovery
cards.subtitle: Found in a wooded ravine near Bicentennial Park

cards.title: The Evidence
cards.subtitle: Physical evidence preserved but no match in databases

ctaLine: Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot
voiceover:
Nineteen year old Maureen Brubaker Farley left her mother's apartment on May tenth, nineteen ninety one. She never made it home.

Maureen was a young mother working at a local mall in Rock Island, Illinois. She'd stopped by to visit her mom for Mother's Day.

Forty eight hours later, her body was discovered in a wooded ravine near Bicentennial Park. She had been sexually assaulted and strangled.

Police preserved DNA evidence from the scene. Despite a robust profile, no match has ever been found in state or federal databases.

Thirty four years later, Maureen's family still searches for answers. Her killer remains unidentified.

Follow Cold Trail for cases the mainstream forgot.
